Subject: Follow-up: MAP draft + post-call next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time on today’s discovery call. I pulled together the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture the milestones we discussed and proposed owners/target dates. High-level recap below: 

- Target scope: Proof-of-concept (pilot) for secure inference of PHI data in a VPC deployment (redwood private) across ingest -> inference -> auditing.
- Key milestones (draft):
  • Milestone 1 — Security questionnaire & SOC 2 evidence review (Owner: Acme/security, Redwood: Marissa) — Target: 2025-07-22
  • Milestone 2 — Technical deep-dive + demo (Owner: Redwood: Nikhil) — Target: 2025-07-29
  • Milestone 3 — Pilot environment provisioning (Owner: Redwood infra) — Target: 2025-08-05
  • Milestone 4 — Pilot run & QA (Owner: Acme + Redwood) — Target close: 2025-08-15

Dependencies called out: procurement approval, KMS/HSM key access, and SOC 2 evidence sign-off.

Next steps: 
1) Please review the attached MAP (ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) and flag any changes to milestones or owners.
2) If the dates above look reasonable, can we lock in the technical deep-dive with Nikhil for the week of 7/28? I’ll propose slots.
3) I’ll loop in procurement if you want us to align the procurement milestone and docs.

I’ll leave the map in edit-friendly format in Drive if you’d like to annotate. Link below in follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for pulling the MAP together. A few notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Appreciate the structure — overall the milestones are correct but our timeline needs to shift. We are in the middle of our Q3 budget reforecast and procurement windows have changed.
- Can we reforecast target close to 2025-09-30 instead of 8/15?
- Security/SOC 2 checklist is now the highest priority — we need SOC 2 evidence and a short whitepaper on how you handle PHI before we can spin up the pilot environment. 
- Procurement (cc’d) will provide an updated procurement timeline. I’ve attached the procurement timeline we referenced (acme_procurement_timeline.pdf).

If Redwood can prioritize the SOC 2 materials and confirm a security call with your security lead in the next two weeks, that will help us keep momentum. Also would like to get a revised MAP incorporating the new dates and reordered milestones.

Thanks —
Samantha
Director, Digital Platforms
Acme Healthcare
